context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about a food trend
purpose: Teach: 豚/チョコレート/新書/農林/カ国/分離/人種/まさしく

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ聞いた？最近インスタで話題の豚肉チョコレートのお店。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? That pork-and-chocolate shop trending on Instagram lately.
lines.style: Casual gossipy tone with rising excitement and conspiratorial lean-in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 知ってる！この前出た新書でも紹介されてて、農林水産省のシェフが考えたんだって。
lines.en: I know! It was introduced in a recent paperback too, apparently a chef from MAFF came up with it.
lines.style: Dreamy yet informed, trailing off with romantic curiosity at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新書にまでなってるの？すごいね、もう数カ国に支店出してるらしいよ。
lines.en: It even made it into a book? Wow, apparently they already have branches in several countries.
lines.style: Surprised exclamation followed by impressed, fast-paced delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも甘いソースと豚を完全に分離して出すスタイルなんだって、なんかロマンチック。
lines.en: But they serve the sweet sauce and pork completely separated, kind of romantic somehow.
lines.style: Soft sighing voice, drifting into wistful daydream territory mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ロマンチック？笑　でも確かに、人種を超えて世界中のファンがついてるって書いてあったよ。
lines.en: Romantic? Haha. But really, it said fans across all races worldwide are into it.
lines.style: Teasing laugh first, then shifting into genuine impressed observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: まさしくブームね。今度の休み、一緒に並びに行かない？
lines.en: It is exactly a boom, isn't it. Want to go line up together on the next day off?
lines.style: Gentle confirming nod followed by warm hopeful invitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 行く行く！開店前から並ぼう、絶対インスタ映えするやつだよ。
lines.en: Yes, let's go! Let's line up before opening, it's totally going to be Insta-worthy.
lines.style: Bright energetic agreement with quick decisive planning voice.
